full_judgment: 6. Mr. Md. Abdur Razzak, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of Mr. S.M. Rezaul Karim has taken me through the impugned judgment and submits that the learned Appellate court committed a gross error of law in allowing recounting of the ballot papers overlooking that the Election petitioner could not lay any foundation for recounting of the ballot papers. The learned Advocate further submits that the Election Tribunal on consideration of the evidence on record passed an order that there was no foundation for re-counting of the ballot papers and without adverting to the said finding of the trial court the Appellate Tribunal has directed recounting of the ballot papers upon misconception of law and facts and thus the impugned judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal.
